assets.ti: Avistamiento de fenómenos extraños en Valencia, Motril y Madrid: 11, 17 y 28 de noviembre de 1979 (Spanish Air Force file, incl. the Manises incident)
assets.de: The Spanish Air Force file on expedientes 791111 / 791117 / 791128 from the Air Operations Command's Intelligence Section. Its summary (pp.2-3) records that on 11 November 1979 TAE flight JK 297 (Palma-Tenerife) reported two intense red lights near Ibiza and diverted to Valencia (Manises), landing at 22:45Z, that the crew never saw an object, and that a fighter scrambled from Albacete made no radar contact; it also covers the 17 November chase near Motril and the 28 November Madrid alert. A document index follows (p.5), then the investigating officer's report and witness statements. 150 pages. Declassified (JEMA 3216) on 11 August 1994. Fuente: Biblioteca Central del Ejército del Aire y del Espacio / Biblioteca Virtual de Defensa. Licensed CC BY 4.0.

assets.ti: Información complementaria sobre el expediente 791128: scramble over Madrid, 28 November 1979 (Spanish Air Force, declassified 1996)
assets.de: A Spanish Air Force supplementary file (the "Bis" volume of expedientes 791111 / 791117 / 791128) from the Air Operations Command's Intelligence Section. Its 1996 summary adds material on the already-declassified expediente 791128: after a July 1994 search request, photocopies of the interceptor scramble in the early hours of 28 November 1979 over Madrid, with the Pegaso duty controller's report and the alert crew's report, plus 1994 Air Force messages. 12 pages; it does not contain the Manises (11 November) narrative, which is in the main file. Declassified (JEMA 6092) on 20 November 1996. Fuente: Biblioteca Central del Ejército del Aire y del Espacio / Biblioteca Virtual de Defensa. Licensed CC BY 4.0.
